core_obligations: The rewriting (proof lines 1201-1213): the author rewrites the functor of homomorphisms out of a fixed module into the constructed module as a functor of homomorphisms out of a tensor product with the flat module appearing in the construction, by a chain of displayed identifications using the hom-tensor adjunction and the description of the constructed module.

Exactness and injectivity (proof lines 1214-1216): the rewritten functor is exact because tensoring by a flat module is exact and the target is injective, so the original functor is exact and the constructed module is injective.
proof_roadmap: Rewrite the hom functor into the constructed module as a hom functor out of a tensor product.
Use exactness of tensoring by a flat module and injectivity of the target.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the module constructed from the double dual is injective (statement lines 1194-1199). The proof is a complete argument: the functor of homomorphisms into the constructed module is rewritten by a chain of displayed identifications, using the hom-tensor adjunction and the description of the construction, as a functor of homomorphisms out of a tensor product with a flat module (proof lines 1201-1213); that functor is exact because tensoring by a flat module is exact and the target is injective, so the constructed module is injective (proof lines 1214-1216). The non-formal content is the chain of adjunction identifications. The claim is H2.
